title: Mrs. Dalloway
rights_basis: Operator review for worldwide distribution with no per-country restriction (D030), same cut-offs as the 2026-09-23 English cohort (public-domain/audits/en-ko-parity-rights-framework-2026-09-23.json). Virginia Woolf died in 1941 and the work was first published in 1925. US: published in or before 1930, so outside the 95-year term (17 U.S.C. 304; 104A restoration also gives at most the remainder of that term). Japan: life+50 plus the 3,794-day wartime addition for Allied works ended by 2005 for authors who died by 1944, before the 2018 extension, and is not revived. Korea: life+50 before 2013 / Art. 3(4). Life+70 and life+80 countries (CO, GQ) expired at the latest by end-2024; Mexico treats authors who died before 1952 as public domain (docs/rights/pd-batch-2026-11-gutenberg.md). Scope is the exact Project Gutenberg plain-text file pinned by SHA-256, without the PG header, license, footer, volunteer credits or name.
rights_notes: Selected for batch gutenberg-2026-11-19. First publication: 1925, London (Hogarth Press) / New York (Harcourt, Brace). Evidence: PG title page: New York, Copyright 1925 (US edition). Base printing: PG transcribed a later US printing: Harcourt, Brace & World, Inc., New York, 'Twenty-third printing' (copyright 1925, renewed by Leonard Woolf). Only the 1925 novel text is used; the later printing's imprint, list of the author's books and the transcriber's note are removed from the Reader body.
